mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate broad economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during monetary tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 1300 thousand units signal housing market weakness, reducing economic activity and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply-side economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a low unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals tight labor markets and impending inflation, triggering monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during late-cycle expansions when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
